title: Review
description: The reviewer's judgement of one WorkItem's change against its request and plan. Written by the reviewer as /workspace/review.json, validated by the orchestrator, and shown in the pull request body. Advisory: it never blocks a pull request. Internal to Factorial, but changed with the same care as the WorkItem contract.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this contract. Incremented only for breaking changes.

verdict.description: approve: ready for a human to merge. request-changes: something must change first. comment: neither, with points worth reading.

correctness.description: Does the change do what it claims, without bugs?

completeness.description: Does it cover everything the request and the plan asked for?

tests.description: Do the tests exercise the change, including its failure cases?

safety.description: Is it free of security problems, data loss and weakened safety limits?

findings.description: Specific points, most important first. At most 50; may be empty.

path.description: Repository-relative path the finding is about.

line.description: Line in the file at the branch head, when the finding is about one place.

severity.description: high: must be addressed before merging. medium: should be addressed. low: worth knowing.

body.description: What is wrong and what to do about it.

summary.description: The judgement in a few sentences. Shown in the pull request body.
